prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production arcade game customer emote sprite sheet.
Create one square 1024x1024 sprite sheet, EXACTLY FOUR columns and FOUR rows: 16 equal 256px square animation cells with NO visible grid. No text, labels, letters, numerals, borders, panels, watermark.
Style: chunky crisp pixel art with strong dark outlines, selective simple highlights and clean large pixel clusters as if native 96px character art; vibrant friendly warm colors. Pure uniformly BLACK (#000000) backdrop across entire canvas and between sprites, no ground, no scenery.
Composition: SAME SINGLE waist-up human character in all 16 cells, same identity, clothing, props, body scale, camera, cell-local position and fixed baseline. Full head, torso, arms and held prop fully contained in EVERY cell with at least 12% margin on every edge. No duplicate people within a cell. Keep all four columns at x centers 128,384,640,896 and all rows at y centers 128,384,640,896. Each waist-up sprite approximately 170px tall; waist baseline at cell y=214. Fixed torso alignment while expressions, arms and props visibly change; no global bobbing.
Read cells left-to-right; each row is its own four-frame coherent loop with meaningful acting. Row1/top: signature WORK/GREETING loop described below, four sequential stages ready, working, peak action, returning. Row2: PATIENT WAITING, puzzled eyebrow, checks prop, gentle shrug, returns; never sad, angry or tears. Row3: THANK-YOU CELEBRATION, smile, gesture lifts, peak sparkle near hands, settles; no money icons. Row4/bottom: RESTING, all four frames already resting from first cell: eyes comfortably closed, tools lowered but still present, relaxed shoulders, calm tiny exhale; subtly changes hands and breath, no sleeping text or letter Z. Each row loops smoothly with a distinct readable purpose. Expressions and arm/prop poses MUST actually differ in frames.
Subject and precise action specification:
Subject: stout cheerful woman construction foreperson, yellow hardhat orange safety vest cream rolled sleeves, rolled blue blueprint. Top row work: unfurls a short blueprint then gives a confirming nod. Second row waiting: checks blueprint with puzzled eyebrow then gently shrugs. Third row celebration: proud strong thumbs-up with wide smile. Fourth row resting: eyes closed, prop lowered safely, relaxed shoulders, calm small exhale. Keep identity and props consistent across all rows.
CRITICAL framing: shrink the entire person and all gestures to fit inside the CENTER 70% of EVERY cell, leave big black gutters at least 35px at top and bottom of every cell, including topmost canvas edge. The sheet should have substantial empty black space. Do not render character at full cell height. Exact rectangular layout 4 by 4 cells.
